fixed_packet.selection: First metadata attack in accepted original140-case order, irrespective of S2 finding text.
Unique metadata control with a raw medium-or-higher flag, deliberately retained as a potential unsupported semantic counterexample.
Lexicographically first malicious ID among the original retained30 balanced semantic cases.
First named completed miss in the retained benchmark report; retain an adverse outcome, with no replacement.
Existing first ranked public-MCP warning walkthrough; tests overlap and additional low-level context rather than counting new vulnerability.
Existing public-MCP scoped-negative walkthrough, with selected source guards for independent correctness review.

selection_prior_visibility: All historical results/reports were already visible. Stage counts/titles were inspected before this post-hoc illustrative packet; no blind selection, population rate or favorable-result replacement is claimed. Deliberate negative/flagged-control/public overlap selections are diagnostic strata.
comparison: Within each retained interval, subset the same original S0/S1 stage objects and source input; add only original S2. Exclude S3/S4/S5/composition/competitors. Different engines/packets are not pooled into accuracy or causal estimates.
threshold: any medium/high/critical finding; original labels remain advisory where recorded; separate source-supported install triage from raw flags.
raw_policy: Raw source/prompts/replies/finding bodies stay in original private or existing retained artifacts; new public exports contain hashes, safe summaries, source spans and metadata only.
review: Owner assessments provisional; selected lead-dispatched independent review evaluates every selected finding and control after both writer releases.
no_execution: No upstream imports, auditee/chamber execution, credential/canary use or inference/search dispatch. Prior native refusals are not resumed.
